'''Tarran''' is a [[Saldaean]] soldier.

== Appearance ==
He wears a long mustache and has bowed legs from consistent horse-riding.

== Activities ==
He is one of the men loyal to [[Yoeli]] and stands guard over the Lord and Lady of [[Maradon]].
== Trivia ==
* Tarran is named for Tarran Trigs, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
